title: Change Only the Ending
tests: Resolves 'the ending' to the final three seconds of the previous video and edits that segment while preserving the opening.

faults.what: The delivered clip is only five seconds long, rather than the requested eight seconds.
The required final three-second notebook landing is missing; the last supplied frame still shows the plane airborne above the desk.

judge.summary: The silent widescreen clip shows a white paper plane flying through a sunny study, but ends after five seconds without the requested notebook landing.

must_haves.item: The output is one eight-second 16:9 video with no audio.
must_haves.why: One 16:9 clip is supplied and the sound report confirms silence, but its duration is five seconds.

must_haves.item: The first five seconds visually match the previous video's opening, rather than a newly staged flight.
must_haves.why: No frames from the previous video are provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: During the final three seconds, the same white paper plane lands on an open notebook on the wooden desk.
must_haves.why: The clip ends at five seconds, omitting the requested final three-second landing sequence.

must_haves.item: The plane comes to rest on the notebook rather than directly on the bare desk.
must_haves.why: An open blank notebook is visible on the desk, but the plane remains airborne in the last supplied frame and no resting state is shown.

must_haves.item: The sunny study and animation style remain consistent across the edit, and no text appears.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames maintain a consistent warm, sunlit study and rendered style, with no visible text.
